Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5303711. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by chembl_id CHEMBL5303711. Require canonical SMILES via INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno. Sort results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
